status: Native Photomerge verified by65 focused Debug tests and1697 final full optimized tests; universal package verified. RAW02 remains open.
features: Native Files/Folder/Add Open Files source collection, remove, preview, six projections, name and blend/fill controls.
Immutable source flattening, working-profile/depth conversion, shared registration, expanded union canvas and optional multiband blending.
Content-aware transparent-area fill with or without blending; independent fill layer for unblended sources.
Stale-preview/source guards, cancel, atomic new unsaved document publication and supported native/PSD persistence/history for subsequent edits.
Shared-source Photato creation/cancel commands, schemas, capabilities/operation state, session/source/lifecycle guards and revocation handling.

api.schema: PhotomergeSettings.apiSchema/sourcesSchema; command sources(id,revision), optional settings/name; cancel operationID.
api.creation: HTTP201 new shared unsaved document, sources/history untouched; input grant/revisions/lifecycle revalidated after work. Cancellation/revocation publishes nothing.
api.adobe: No dedicated Photomerge route in pinned published v2 contract. Existing create-composite and execute-actions alignment/blend interfaces preserved; new-document orchestration explicitly Photato-specific.
api.endpoint_groups: Five partial/three unimplemented; no invented Adobe endpoint.

limits: Native source collection supports2–16 files, one folder of readable images, or open-document snapshots. API supports2–7 explicitly shared sources, retaining one slot for the new panorama; transfer permission is required.
Each photograph is flattened, then converted to the first source working profile and depth. Internal source layer structures are not embedded in the output; original documents/files remain unchanged.

Alignment limits16MP/source and32MP combined. Expanded canvas limit16MP; blended output4MP and16MP combined grid. Hole-only fill without blending is4MP. API additionally enforces4MP canvas/64layers/128MiB. No silent clipping to fit a limit.

Bilinear full-resolution warp and feature-based fractional placements can add an enclosing border pixel. Synthetic known-crop tests allow<0.25px matching RMS and<0.02 mean scene-sample error; not Photoshop pixel equality.

Blending reuses the native multiband output and retains masked source layers hidden beneath a merged Panorama layer. Unblended fill adds only hole pixels in a separate layer. Photoshop output-layer construction/defaults remain unqualified.
Lens distortion/vignette correction, EXIF focal inference, manual control points, difficult subjects/large production panoramas and exact Adobe pixels remain open.
Native NSHosting checks are offscreen; live UI, physical Intel/macOS14/26 and complete Photoshop equivalence remain open. HDR merging/deghosting and stack statistics remain major work.

tests.diagnostic_correction: Actual weighted-luma fits were fractional by~0.017px; exact integer fixture expectation was invalid. Speculative bounding-tolerance change was reverted byte-for-byte to175. Independent scene/coverage checks replace invalid integer-only expectations.

next_major: Merge to HDR Pro: bracketed exposures, alignment, radiance merge/deghosting and tone mapping.
